name: Teun.ai GEO — AI Visibility Optimizer
author: Teun.ai

sections.description:
Teun.ai GEO helps you optimize your WordPress pages for AI-powered search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude, and Gemini.

Unlike traditional SEO plugins that focus on Google rankings, Teun.ai GEO focuses on Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — making sure AI systems can find, understand, and recommend your content.

What It Does

📊 GEO Score Analysis
Analyze any page or post directly from the WordPress editor. Get a detailed GEO Score based on:

  • Technical AI-Readiness — Schema markup, meta tags, heading structure, page speed signals
  • Content Quality — Word count, readability, keyword usage, internal links, FAQ sections
  • E-E-A-T Signals — Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness markers

🕷️ AI Bot Activity Tracking
See which AI bots are crawling your site in real-time:

  • OpenAI (GPTBot, ChatGPT-User)
  • Anthropic (ClaudeBot)
  • Perplexity (PerplexityBot)
  • Google AI (Google-Extended, Gemini)
  • Meta AI, Microsoft Copilot, Apple (Applebot)

👥 AI Referral Tracking
Track visitors arriving from AI platforms:

  • ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, You.com

💬 Prompt Suggestions
Get suggested prompts that real users might ask AI platforms about your business — based on your page topic, location, and content.

💡 Actionable Recommendations
Specific, prioritized recommendations to improve your AI visibility, with clear explanations for each.

🛰️ AI Activity Dashboard
A dedicated dashboard page showing:

  • Bot crawls and AI visitor statistics (7, 30, 90 day filters)
  • Per-platform breakdown with visual charts
  • Most crawled pages
  • Recent activity log

Key Features

  • Zero API calls — All analysis runs locally in PHP, zero external dependencies
  • Per-page analysis — Analyze individual pages directly in the editor sidebar
  • Works with any theme — No frontend changes, admin-only
  • SEO plugin compatible — Integrates with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress, and All in One SEO (reads focus keywords)
  • WordPress dashboard widget — Quick overview of AI activity and GEO scores
  • Lightweight — No impact on frontend performance
  • Translation ready — Full internationalization support with .pot file included

Premium

Want to test if your pages actually appear in ChatGPT and Perplexity responses? Teun.ai Premium offers live AI visibility scanning with AI-generated commercial prompts.

About GEO

GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) is the practice of optimizing web content for AI-powered search and discovery. As more users turn to ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews for answers, traditional SEO alone is no longer enough. GEO ensures your content is structured, authoritative, and easily understood by large language models.

Development

The Gutenberg sidebar source code is located in gutenberg/src/index.js.
The compiled build in gutenberg/build/ is generated using @wordpress/scripts.

To rebuild from source: cd gutenberg, then npm install, then npm run build.

Privacy Policy

This plugin:

  • Does not collect any personal data in the free version
  • Does not track user behavior
  • Does not share data with third parties in the free version
  • Stores AI bot visit data locally in your WordPress database
  • Premium features (optional) may send page metadata to Teun.ai servers — see Teun.ai Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Teun.ai GEO”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. Open any page or post in the editor — the Teun.ai GEO metabox appears below the editor

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the zip file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 8.0 or higher
sections.faq:
What is GEO?

GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimization. It is the practice of optimizing your content so AI platforms like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews can understand, reference, and recommend your pages.

Does this plugin make external API calls?

The free version makes zero external API calls. All analysis runs locally in PHP on your WordPress server. The only external request is fetching your site’s own HTML to detect schema markup (a standard WordPress pattern). Premium features (optional) connect to Teun.ai servers for live AI scanning.

Does it work with my SEO plugin?

Yes. Teun.ai GEO integrates with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress, and All in One SEO to read focus keywords. It does not conflict with any SEO plugin.

Does it affect my site speed?

No. The plugin only runs in the WordPress admin area. It adds zero frontend code, scripts, or styles. The AI bot tracking uses minimal server resources.

How is this different from traditional SEO plugins?

Traditional SEO plugins optimize for Google’s traditional search results. Teun.ai GEO optimizes for AI-powered search engines that generate answers using your content. Both are important — they complement each other.

What AI bots does it track?

GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot (OpenAI), ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot (Anthropic), PerplexityBot (Perplexity), Google-Extended, Gemini (Google), Meta-ExternalFetcher (Meta), BingBot/Copilot (Microsoft), and Applebot (Apple).
